meta.name: grill-me
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.

copy.tagline: 用访谈式提问帮您打磨计划与设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常常需要把不成熟的想法梳理得清晰可行
copy.tagline_en: Hone your plan or design through relentless questioning.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to sharpen rough ideas into clear plans.

howto.what: 装上后,当你想完善一个方案或设计,Claude 会启动一次 /grilling 会话:它以连续追问的方式访谈你,反复审视计划细节,迫使你把想法说清楚。
howto.when: 当你想检查一个方案、设计或计划有没有漏洞、让它更清楚时,这个会话就会展开。

say.text: 帮我 grill 一下我这个产品上线计划。
say.note: Claude 会进入 /grilling,开始逐条追问计划。

say.text: 来一场 /grilling,审一下这份活动方案。
say.note: 它会针对方案连续提问查漏补缺。

say.text: 我的设计稿准备上线,你拷问拷问它。
say.note: 启动针对该设计的追问式检验。

howto.what_en: When installed and you want to refine a plan or design, Claude runs a /grilling session: it interviews you with a relentless series of questions, drilling into the details of your plan.
howto.when_en: It kicks in when you ask to stress-test a plan, design, or idea and want to expose gaps or sharpen it.

say_en.text: Please grill my product launch plan.
say_en.note: Claude starts the /grilling session and questions you point by point.

say_en.text: Run a /grilling on this event proposal.
say_en.note: It asks a series of questions to find weak spots.
It starts the questioning session for the design.
